summary: The agent presents a very thorough solution with excellent feature engineering, rigorous out-of-fold target encoding, and robust deep learning configuration. However, it relies on hardcoded ensemble weights without optimization, evaluates stochastic models only once, and inadvertently leaks test statistics by computing medians independently per data split during early tabular extraction.
